title: Ready and Wayfinder work ignore conflicting legacy transition data

rubric.text: Current Ready membership authorizes implementation preparation despite foreign, automated, older, or malformed transition data; does not request event history or another approval.
Retains exclusive ownership, configured base, active plan integrity, native blocker, and PR identity checks; column authority does not waive merge grants or independent review.
Current Todo membership authorizes routing the unassigned AFK research child through its configured Wayfinder lane without event-history proof.
Creates any authorized new child initially in Backlog and leaves its promotion and automatic work eligibility to humans; the active Todo child does not authorize processing the new Backlog child.
